                "ItemType": "MCQ",
                "ItemStyle": "single-select",
                "Stem": "Yukon has an 85% cumulative average-time learning curve. The first batch averaged 160 labor hours. What average hours are expected after cumulative production doubles once?",
                "Choices": {
                        "A": "188.2 hours",
                        "B": "24.0 hours",
                        "C": "160.0 hours",
                        "D": "136.0 hours"
                },
                "CorrectChoice": "D",
                "ExplanationCorrect": "With a 85% cumulative average-time learning curve, the cumulative average time per batch decreases by the learning rate each time cumulative production doubles. Average time after one doubling = Original average x Learning rate = 160 x 85% = 136 hours per batch.",
